name: Endless Dark
body:
School evocation [darkness]; Level antipaladin 4, bard 4, cleric/oracle 4, inquisitor 4, lathspell 4, legendary ninja 4, magus 4, shaman 4, sorcerer/wizard 4, white necromancer 4

CAST

Casting Time 1 minute

EFFECT

Range 0 ft.
Area 1 mile/level
Duration 1 hour/level (D.

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as darkness except as noted above and it is not cast upon an object, it is cast upon a point in space. From that point an area of 1 mile per level is plunged into darkness. This darkness is not contained within walls and cannot be covered or contained.
